text.tspan: One parameterized module for leaf / router / stage / root / monolithic; all board-to-board glue lives here
ControlBoard #(IS_ROOT, IS_LEAF, EVENT_MODE, DATA_SRC, HAS_PS, NCHILD, CHILD_DW[], CHILD_RAW[], NPS, P, M, D_IN, K, N, H, RAW_OUT, …)
non-root: relay ev_* from parent (= bc_ev)
bc_ps = [ own DCB ps | ps_in[0..NPS) | gap ]
own + gap slots stamped with cur_attempt
child c's one finish bit → every line in
IDLE → EXEC → DRAIN; abort = |(post_select & (ps_att XNOR attempt))
adopts ev_attempt (FORWARD); stale data = tag mismatch → dropped
out: reset, set_in_data_to_zero, out_ev_*, out_attempt, discard
reset = system rst, NOT board_reset (handles abort/finish via the event bus)
(the DCB det-finish only fires after every child's finish-tagged
detector arrived ⇒ 'my whole subtree has drained')
